packet_rule: ERN-SPORTS-001-RENDER-PACKET-001 is an execution packet for ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-002. It introduces no new design, loosens no lock, and alters neither the correspondent, the necklace, the tablet mark, the cup rule, the field direction, the player set, the routes, the footer, the six data figures nor the format family. Placements, colour tokens and band boundaries are measured from the registered reference plate. Any change to a locked value requires ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-003 and a reissued packet. ERN-SPORTS-LOCK-001 is preserved unedited as the historical lock.
